run_STN_MNIST_training: run the MNIST spatial transformer network training with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate
build_STNAgent: build a Salina Agent with a spatial transformer network for MNIST image classification
test_STNAgent: test the STNAgent model on a test dataset and return loss and accuracy metrics
refactor_STN_forward: refactor the STNAgent forward pass to change the number of spatial transformer transformations
review_STN_localization: review the STNAgent localization network and affine matrix regressor for spatial transformations
